name: Elizabeth A. Pascal

biography.text: Public professional directories report that Pascal earned a B.S. from Rutgers University–Camden (1993) and a J.D. there in 2000, practiced at Flaster Greenberg, and served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney. The court’s current profile confirms her Camden assignment.
